nodes.author: AhmadiImi
nodes.text: China's society faces a new virus with the same symptoms as the flu, such as coughing, fever, stuffy or running nose, in people of all ages. Some unofficial reporters pointed out this is an HMPV virus, or so-called human metapneumovirus, but it has not been clear.
